g.text: Variants: the return channel, and where workers run

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(248, 250, 252), rgb(21, 23, 25)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(203, 213, 225), rgb(47, 56, 66));

g.text: Results, questions and approvals reach you when the voice AI
calls: send, ask, get_reply, status. After you hang up they
wait for the next voice conversation.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 247, 237), rgb(30, 23, 15)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(251, 146, 60), rgb(175, 84, 10));

g.text: After 10 min without a voice call (VOICE_GW_TELEGRAM_AFTER), questions
and approvals also go to your Telegram chat, each once; results wait.
From Telegram it takes only /stop (kill switch), from your chat only.
On when .secrets/telegram_token and telegram_chat_id both exist.
